Carolina Panthers vs. Cleveland Browns Week 3 TV Map

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:21
Instaread

See which cities get to watch the Panthers vs. Browns game on television this week.

by Chris Pokorny
Sep 23, 2026, 8:36 PM EDT
22Comments

The Week 3 game between the Cleveland Browns and the Carolina Panthers will air on FOX at 1:00 PM ET on Sunday.

Announcers: Chris Myers & Mark Schlereth

Ohio Coverage: Some of Ohio will get to see the game, but not the Toledo and Cincinnati areas. Dayton will see the game, along with Columbus. In Northeast Ohio, the game will air on WJW (Channel 8.1).

National Coverage: Nationally, most of North Carolina and South Carolina will see the game. Otherwise, it has the bare minimum of national coverage.

WEEK 3 NFL GAMES AIRING NATIONALLY OR IN CLEVELAND

  • Thursday - 8:15 PM ET: Atlanta Falcons vs. Green Bay Packers (Prime)
  • Sunday - 1:00 PM ET: Carolina Panthers vs. Cleveland Browns (FOX)
  • Sunday - 1:00 PM ET: Cincinnati Bengals vs. Pittsburgh Steelers (CBS)
  • Sunday - 4:25 PM ET: Baltimore Ravens vs. Dallas Cowboys (CBS)
  • Sunday - 8:20 PM ET: Los Angeles Rams vs. Denver Broncos (NBC/Peacock)
  • Monday - 8:15 PM ET: Philadelphia Eagles vs. Chicago Bears (ABC/ESPN)

Let’s have a roll call — if you’re a Browns fans outside of Ohio, let us know if your city gets to see Cleveland on TV this week.

Social Media & Embedded Content

Content embedded on our sites (e.g. social media posts, video clips, polls and games) originates from third party sources such as social media platforms, video sharing sites, or other third party websites.
